notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
You control at least three creatures that are either Balloons or that share a creature type with the nonlegendary creature.
easyPrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to The Jolly Balloon Man.
description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.
